# QuimeraTech

> Portuguese software house specializing in custom software development, technology consulting, and Cloud architecture.

## About

QuimeraTech helps companies transform their operations and digital products through software engineering, custom CRM, and Cloud solutions.

## Services

- Custom software development
- Cloud consulting and architecture
- Custom CRM
- Digital transformation and systems integration
